summary: Defines extensions to the stateful PCE Communication Protocol (PCEP) so label switched paths can be computed, activated, set up and torn down on a schedule, based on time intervals and actual resource usage in a centralized network. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Some network paths are needed only at certain times, like a bus route that runs only at rush hour. This document lets a central planner reserve a path for set times and then release it.
